newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada hopes to land $1.5 billion in Asia trip.
newsitem.headline: Canada hopes to land $1.5 billion in Asia trip.

text.p: The government of Canada expects more than $2 billion Canadian ($1.5 billion U.S.) in business deals to be signed during an Asian trade mission Prime Minister Jean Chretien plans to lead in January, a senior government official said on Thursday.
Chretien will be joined by nine of Canada's 10 provincial premiers and 400 businessmen on what he dubs "Team Canada."
The mission is to leave Canada on January 8, arriving in South Korea on January 9, going to the Philippines on January 14 and to Thailand on January 16. They leave on January 20.
Chretien then travels on to France for an official visit from January 21-24, the official said.

During such trade missions, executives often take the opportunity to sign deals which had already been in the works, but the presence of a government leader often is the spur to conclude them or to reach new agreements.
